title: On Wishing for a quiet life in the hills
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：wish　|　正文 365 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the clerk ① wished for a quiet life in the hills twice over, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② wishes for a quiet life in the hills year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ wish for a quiet life in the hills at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ wished for a quiet life in the hills before — a line in the file for May 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Wishing for a quiet life in the hills twice over, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ wish them well on the long road year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Wish them well on the long road at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ wishes them well on the long road twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ wished for a quiet life in the hills again when nobody else would.

⑩ To wish for a quiet life in the hills, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody wishes for a quiet life in the hills year after year again and somebody must wish for a quiet life in the hills twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 希望（一般过去式 wished for a quiet life in the hills：1965 年书记员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 希望（一般现在 wishes for a quiet life in the hills：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 希望（不定式 to wish for a quiet life in the hills：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 希望（过去完成时 had wished for a quiet life in the hills：1959 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 希望（动名词 wishing for a quiet life in the hills 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 祝愿（wish them well on the long road：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去祝愿祝他们在那条长路上顺遂）
G. v. 祝愿（wish them well on the long road：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 希望（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 wishes them well on the long road，而母亲又一次 wished for a quiet life in the hills）

answers.why: wish 意为“希望”，1965 年书记员来回两遍希望盼着在山里过安静日子，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 wished。
wish 意为“希望”，自那以后书记员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 wishes。
wish 意为“希望”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯希望盼着在山里过安静日子”，此处为不定式 to wish for a quiet life in the hills。
wish 意为“希望”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人希望过，故用过去完成时 had wished。
wish 意为“希望”，书记员说“希望盼着在山里过安静日子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 wishing for a quiet life in the hills 作主语。
wish 意为“祝愿”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去祝愿祝他们在那条长路上顺遂”，should ever 之后用原形 wish them well on the long road。
wish 意为“祝愿”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻祝愿祝他们在那条长路上顺遂（wish them well on the long road at once），以后再也不要提起。
wish 意为“希望”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例祝愿祝他们在那条长路上顺遂，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 wishes。
wish 意为“希望”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍希望盼着在山里过安静日子，用一般过去式 wished 叙述。
wish 意为“希望”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要希望盼着在山里过安静日子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 wish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the clerk wished for a quiet life in the hills twice over, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk wishes for a quiet life in the hills year after year whenever the office asks.
Wishing for a quiet life in the hills twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever wish them well on the long road year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office wishes them well on the long road twice over every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother wished for a quiet life in the hills again, and the office remembered that half.
